summary: Aspen Aerogels filed an 8-K to provide an update on a prior explosion at its East Providence facility on April 8, 2026. The incident damaged a high-temperature oven, halted operations, and injured eleven employees (since released). The facility remains offline pending investigation and remediation. The company has initiated insurance claims for business interruption and property damage. No special-situation transaction is involved; this is an operational incident disclosure under Regulation FD.
